title: What Is Dalton's Atomic Theory?
description:
What's Really Inside an Atom?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GHZDsiH7L7A

Dalton's atomic theory: every element has its own kind of atom, and each kind has its own weight.

social.hook: Every element is made of its own kind of atom, and each kind has its own weight.
social.question: What is Dalton's atomic theory?
social.alt: Hook caption EACH ATOM over Dalton's theory beat; elements combine in fixed amounts.
